lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 4 distinct high-contrast vertical line segments. The spacing between the first and second lines is significantly wider than the spacing between the second and third lines.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The fourth (most posterior) line segment is fragmented into a dashed pattern and terminates in the mid-torso region before reaching the ventral fringe.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of approximately 6 high-contrast white spots is located on the posterior flank, posterior to the final vertical stripe and superior to the hind-limb joint.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: A subgroup of 3 spots on the upper haunch aligns into a semi-linear descending diagonal toward the posterior of the animal.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Lyrate curvature trajectory; horns exhibit an initial vertical-oblique ascent from the skull, followed by a lateral flare and a final inward/posterior convergence at the tips.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The pixel distance between terminal tips is approximately 2.3 times the pixel width of the combined horn bases.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ivory tipping accounts for approximately 12% of the total vertical horn structure length.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a white chevron marking on the nasal bridge, two distinct white patches on the lower throat/neck region, and a prominent white dorsal mane extending the length of the spine.
